verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਦੂੰ ਨੀਵੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਹੋਈ ਓਡੀਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabh dhoo(n) neevee dharat hai aap gavai hoiee oddeenee|

en.bdb: The earth is the most humble which eschewing ego is firm and steady.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਪੈਰਾ ਹੇਠਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: dheeraj dharam sa(n)tokh dhiraR pairaa heTh rahai liv leenee|

en.bdb: Deeply rooted in fortitude, dharma and contentment it remains tranquil under feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਚਰਣ ਛੁਹਿ ਆਢੀਣੀ ਹੋਈ ਲਾਖੀਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: saadh janaa(n) dhe charan chhuh aaddeenee hoiee laakheenee|

en.bdb: Touching the holy feet of the saints, it earlier being worth half a penny now becomes worth lacs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਛਲਕ ਰੇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੀਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat boo(n)dh suhaavanee chhahabar chhalak ren hoi reenee|

en.bdb: In the rain of love, the earth gets satiated with delight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਇ ਪਤੀਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: miliaa maan nimaaneeaai piram piaalaa peei pateenee|

en.bdb: Only the humble get adorned with glory and the earth, quaffing the cup of the love of the Lord gets satiated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਲੁਣੈ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jo beejai soiee lunai sabh ras kas bahu ra(n)g ra(n)geenee|

en.bdb: Amongst variegated flora, sweet and bitter tastes, and colours on earth, one reaps whatever one sows.
Gurmukhs (in their humility like the earth) get fruit of delight.
